settings.title: Stairs feel like a decision
settings.body: That flush of dread before every staircase — up to bed, down to the laundry. You start counting steps.

settings.title: You quietly stopped doing things
settings.body: The garden, the long walk, the dance floor. Nobody announced it. Your knees just made the call for you.

settings.title: Standing wears you down
settings.body: A shift, a queue, a kitchen afternoon. By the end your knees are doing all the complaining.

settings.title: Mornings start rusty
settings.body: That first step out of bed has an ache built in. It loosens eventually — but you shouldn’t have to wait for it.

settings.title: Swelling that won’t quit
settings.body: After a busy day the puffiness settles in and lingers, long after you’ve put your feet up.

settings.title: That “might give out” feeling
settings.body: On a curb, a wet floor, a hike downhill — the little wobble that makes you brace and slow right down.

settings.title: Graduated compression
settings.body: A medical-grade nylon/spandex knit hugs the joint to support tired, achy knees through a long day.

settings.title: Anatomical gel ring
settings.body: A silicone ring cradles and centers your kneecap — the difference between targeted support and a plain tube.

settings.title: Encourages circulation
settings.body: Gentle, even pressure supports healthy blood flow so your knees feel fresher for longer.

settings.title: Helps calm swelling
settings.body: Consistent compression can help manage the everyday puffiness that builds up after activity.

settings.title: Breathable all-day comfort
settings.body: Moisture-wicking and slim enough to disappear under trousers — wear it morning to night.

settings.title: Dual non-slip cuffs
settings.body: Two silicone grip bands keep it exactly where you put it. No rolling, bunching, or sliding down.

settings.title: Real, everyday relief
settings.body: Support where you feel it most, so the day stops revolving around your knees.

settings.title: Steadier on your feet
settings.body: The gel ring helps you feel centered and confident on stairs and uneven ground.

settings.title: Less end-of-day swelling
settings.body: Even compression helps manage the puffiness that creeps in after a busy day.

settings.title: Move more freely
settings.body: Get back to the walks, errands and hobbies you’d quietly started avoiding.

settings.title: Comfort that lasts
settings.body: Breathable, slim and light — comfortable enough to forget you’re wearing it.

settings.title: Gym to everyday
settings.body: From a workout to the supermarket, one sleeve that keeps up with your whole day.

settings.title: Slip it on
settings.body: Pull it up so the gel ring sits around your kneecap. The grip cuffs do the rest.

settings.title: Compression goes to work
settings.body: Graduated pressure and the stabilizer ring support the joint the moment it’s on.

settings.title: Move with confidence
settings.body: Stairs, errands, a long walk — go about your day feeling steady and supported.

settings.q: How long can I wear it each day?
settings.a: Most people wear Orteva comfortably for several hours at a time, and many keep it on through a full day. Start with a few hours, see how your knee feels, and build up. If anything feels too tight, size up — exchanges are free.

settings.q: Can I really wear it all day?
settings.a: Yes. It’s breathable, moisture-wicking and slim enough to sit under trousers, so it’s designed for all-day wear. We suggest taking it off overnight to give your skin a break.

settings.q: Is it good for arthritis or stiff knees?
settings.a: Orteva is a wellness and support garment that provides comfort and compression, which many people with everyday stiffness find reassuring. It is not a medical device and is not intended to treat or cure any condition. If you have a diagnosed condition, please check with your healthcare provider.
Absolutely. Plenty of customers wear Orteva for walks, runs, hikes, lifting and court sports. The dual grip cuffs keep it in place while you move.

settings.q: How do I choose my size and side?
settings.a: Size is chosen by body weight (S–XL) for a genuine fit — see the size guide in the buy box. Because the shaping is mirrored per knee, just pick Left or Right for each sleeve.

settings.q: How do I wash and care for it?
settings.a: Hand wash cool with mild soap, or a gentle machine cycle in a laundry bag. Lay flat to dry. Avoid the tumble dryer and fabric softener so the knit and silicone keep their grip.
